## Selected projects

- [AGERE](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/agere) — recruitment agent built with Google ADK, RAG, Streamlit, and Gemini.
- [BITA](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/bita) — local AI OCR invoice manager built with Gemini OCR, React, and Vite.
- [SB0](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/sb0) — local-first second brain with RAG and a knowledge graph.
- [Tool Stash](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/tool-stash) — agentic bookmarking and tool discovery.
- [Roznama](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/roznama) — Markdown notes and personal wiki with Git sync.
- [Notion Vault](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/notion-vault) — portable local password manager.
- [Resources Heaven](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/resources-heaven) — community-maintained technology and AI resource hub.
- [Agentic Learning-Mentor](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/agentic-learning-mentor) — adaptive teaching skill for AI-first developer environments.
- [Intelligent Carpooling App](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/intelligent-carpooling-app) — mobile ride matching with route overlap and Mapbox.
- [TechdioApp](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/techdioapp) — cross-platform technology learning app.
- [Prompt Inspector](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/prompt-inspector) — local prompt analysis, hardening, and evaluation tool.
- [Arduino Night Patrol](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/arduino-night-patrol) — embedded surveillance robot with sensor-based alerts.
- [Student Management System](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/student-management-system) — academic administration web application.
- [Arduino Vehicle Speed Detector](https://www.engrabm.com/projects/arduino-vehicle-speed-detector) — IR-based speed measurement workshop project.
